To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the decision to choose teaching profession was mostly affected by social utility values; (b) there was a significant difference between female and male teacher candidates' scores for most motivation factors; (c) the decision to become a teacher was mostly affected by intrinsic motivation; (d) there was a positive relationship between motivation to become a teachers and beliefs about teaching; (e) there was no significant difference between the motivation to become a school teachers and the satisfaction with their choice.
the most important reasons for choosing the profession of teaching were the social utility values and the desire to teach, whereas the least important reason was the lack of alternatives.
